illustrae.name:
"A scientific diagram with three horizontal panels stacked vertically, each representing one signaling axis. All three panels share the same left-to-right flow direction.
Panel 1 — Wnt axis: Wnt ligand → Frizzled receptor → β-catenin stabilization and nuclear translocation → nuclear activation of MYC and SOX2.
Panel 2 — JAK/STAT axis: Cytokine ligand → JAK kinase → STAT3 phosphorylation and nuclear translocation → nuclear activation of SOX2, NANOG, and MYC. STAT3 is annotated as both signaling intermediate and transcriptional regulator.
Panel 3 — Hedgehog axis: Hedgehog ligand → Patched/Smoothened → GLI transcription factor activation → nuclear activation of NANOG and SOX2.
Each panel flows left to right: extracellular signal on the far left, intracellular cascade in the middle, nuclear transcription factors on the right.
On the far right, all three panels converge into a single shared outcome box listing: self-renewal, tumor initiation, apoptosis resistance, and differentiation block. This box is labeled CSC drug resistance phenotype.
SOX2 and MYC appear across multiple panels, visually indicating they are shared convergence points across pathways."
